title: WebFence · Desktop laboratory
intro: M0 synthetic examples. Open M1 Scan for authorized projects and bounded HTTP checks; CVE and AI are not active yet.
empty: Load the examples to explore the desktop prototype.
select: Select a row to read its synthetic evidence.
selected: %s · Synthetic evidence, not a security finding
footer: Synthetic examples are discarded on exit. Projects and redacted M1 scan results are saved locally.
example_summary: GUI evaluation example. No verified vulnerability.
preference_error: Unable to read or save the language preference. The selection remains active for this session.
scan_intro: Alpha: use only targets you are authorized to test. A project records your declaration; it does not prove ownership. GET only, one origin and one seed at a time. Links are visited only when you opt in.
scan_confirmed: I confirm I am authorized to test this origin
scan_delete_confirm: Permanently delete the selected project and all its scan results? Separately created backups are not deleted.
scan_store_error: Local store unavailable. Close other WebFence instances or check the data folder.
scan_invalid_date: Enter a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
scan_created: Project created. Select it and configure the scan.
scan_running: Scan running. Progress counts visits, not site coverage.
scan_finished: Scan finished; review coverage and observations.
scan_no_runs: No saved scans for this project.
scan_incomplete: Incomplete coverage or interrupted scan; a negative result does not imply absence of vulnerabilities.
scan_queue_complete: Planned queue drained; whole-site coverage is not attested.
scan_visit: Visit %d · HTTP %d · %s v%d · %s: %s [%s] · discovery %s · links %d · forms %d · out of scope %d · invalid %d
scan_evidence_content_type_unknown: Content type could not be determined
report_remaining_unknown: other untested areas cannot be counted
report_redaction: Visited routes, raw bodies and headers were not retained. A signature does not prove observation accuracy or completeness.
m2_intro: Use an explicit CVE and product/version signal for this selected run. A match is an assessment, not a tested vulnerability. Exports keep untested areas visible.
m2_session_note: Assessments are held for the selected run in this session until export. No CVE check is run automatically.
m2_trust_unavailable: Report trust registry unavailable; signed export and verification are disabled.
m2_invalid_signal: Choose a signal method and confidence.
m2_cache_updated: Cache updated. The last successful snapshot is available.
m2_assessed: Assessment added for the selected run.
m2_key_created: Signing key created: %s. SHA-256 fingerprint: %s. Confirm it through an independent channel before trusting it elsewhere.
m2_verified: Valid bundle under local trust: %s (%s). Revocation and clock freshness are not guaranteed offline.
m2_invalid_window: Enter a past or current NVD date window of at most 120 days.
m2_invalid_path: Choose an absolute path for a new bundle.
m2_cpe_help: With a full CPE, separate vendor, product and part fields are ignored. The version must match the CPE.
m2_part_required: Select the product's CPE part for NVD.
m2_backport_confirmed: I attest a backport for this CVE and version
m2_verification_confirmed: I attest an explicit CVE verification
m2_attestation_conflict: Backport and positive verification conflict; choose one attestation.
m2_backport_incomplete: Confirm the backport and enter an HTTPS advisory and valid reference; the link is not opened.
m2_verification_incomplete: Confirm verification and enter a method and valid reference; WebFence does not run the CVE check.
m2_rotate_confirm: Rotate key %s? The old key remains in the registry for historical reports, but can no longer sign.
m2_revoke_confirm: Revoke key %s? Local verification will reject reports signed with it.
m2_key_rotated: New key: %s. SHA-256 fingerprint: %s. Share the new fingerprint over an independent channel.
m2_key_revoke_done: Key %s revoked in the local registry.
m2_import_incomplete: Choose an absolute descriptor path and enter the SHA-256 fingerprint obtained through an independent channel.
m2_signer_help: Imported public keys verify reports, but signing requires the private key in the local credential store.
